title: Same District. Four Thousand Years Apart.

vo.text: Two things happened in the same Thai district, four thousand years apart.
By two thousand BC, people here were already growing rice. The oldest confirmed in Thailand.
In 1945, in that same district, a farmer smelled jasmine in his field. He kept the seed.
Out of a hundred ninety-nine panicles, row one-oh-five won. In 1959 it got a name. Khao Dawk Mali 105.
It carried Thailand to the top of the world's rice trade, and held it thirty-one years.
Today Thailand is third. India ships three times as much.
